decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's established offer, so its in-house expertise lets it interpret market results and refine the line.
The skin and hair supplement fits the firm's existing pharmacy supplement line, which it understands well enough to learn from early results and improve.
The joint health supplement extends the established product range and draws on related knowledge the firm already holds.
The immune supplement is the newest addition to a familiar range, so its early results can be assimilated and acted on by a firm with its own development.

Although the generic is distant from the firm's established offer and was hit by the 2018 valsartan problem, strong in-house quality control and R&D give the firm the capacity to manage the issue and keep a core generic.

The OTC triptan lies outside the established offer, but the firm's own R&D and pharmaceutical expertise give it enough related knowledge to assimilate results in the consumer health segment it is expanding.
